name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, SMC Global Securities Ltd offers financial services, with operations spanning across Broking, Distribution & Trading, Financing, and also Insurance Broking, supported by their subsidiary companies
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) Broking, Distribution & Trading:
Facilitates buying and selling of securities, catering to retail and institutional clients.
b) Insurance Broking:
The company, through SMC Insurance
Brokers Pvt. Ltd, sells insurance policies, leveraging a digital-first servicing approach 
to both B2B and B2C networks, AI-driven distribution and a vast POSP/MISP network.
c) Financing:
Moneywise Financial Services Pvt. Ltd is their NBFC arm which provides lending products, including SME loans, supply chain financing, and gold loans, with asset management and risk control measures. MFSPL also supports small businesses and self-employed individuals 
d) Discount Broking:
Moneywise Finvest Limited offers a discount broking platform viz. Stoxkart which has cost-effective brokerage plans, advanced trading tools, and strategic market insights. The platform also provides advanced features such as option chain with open interest and trading capabilities through both Trading View and Chart IQ charting interfaces. Further, it delivers detailed stock insights powered by Markets Mojo, covering 2,000 listed companies. Also, in FY24, it has launched the Smart Trader plan. In FY25, the client base stood at 1.17 million
e) Merchant Banking:
SMC Capitals Ltd, their Category I Merchant Banking arm, provides corporate advisory, fund-raising and M&A solutions. It is also a partner with Translink Corporate Finance, which is a global leader in mid-market cross-border M&A services operating in over 35 countries.
f) Wealth Management:
The company offers PMS services, client-centric advisory and relationship management through SMC Investments & Advisors Limited. It serves 11,763 clients, managing an AUM of ₹948 crores as of FY25
g) Broking and Clearing services:
SMC Global IFSC Pvt. Limited provides broking and clearing services on NSEIX, India INX and IIBX to its clients. SMC Global IFSC Pvt. Ltd., in FY25, holds a market share of 48.05% in gold and 36.60% in silver traded at the exchange. 
h) Real estate:
It started dealing in GIFT city through SMC Real Estate Advisors Private Limited

pros: Stock is trading at 0.96 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.2%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
